Interface Unique

All Known Implementing Classes:
MalevolentKitchen, SubaruShirt, UnlimitedHollowPurple
public interface Unique
Marker interface for items that can only appear once per run.

When a Unique item is offered as a drop or chest reward, GameManager removes it from the pool so it will never be offered again in the same session. The interface carries no methods; its purpose is to enable instanceof Unique checks in the drop / chest logic.
